name: Warlock
author: Johan Markström
description: Witchcraft is a crime in the Empire, but that doesn't stop magicians from finding employ with wealthy patrons. In Mordheim they barter their perilous craft for wyrdstone and a chance to uncover magical items lost in the ruins.

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select a visible enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter. Subtract (X/2) from that fighter's Move, Fight and Shoot characteristics until the end of the battle round.

abilities.name: Flight of Zimmerman
abilities.text: Magical ability. This fighter makes a free move action, and for that move action, they count as flying. However, while flying, they cannot move vertically upwards more than (X)".

abilities.name: Fires of U'Zhul
abilities.text: Magical ability. Select an enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter to be the target and roll (X) dice. For each roll of 3+, allocate 2 damage points to the target. For each roll of 6, allocate 2 damage points to all fighters within 2" of (and visible to) the target.
